text:
Predicates:
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Donated(x) ::: x was donated.
No(x, y) ::: there are no x in y.
Premises:
MountainRange(picuris) ∧ (In(picuris, newMexico) ∨ In(picuris, texas)) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(juanDeOnate, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
Donated(hardingPegmatiteMine) ∧ In(hardingPegmatiteMine, picuris) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
∀x (MountainRange(x) ∧ In(x, texas) → ¬∃y (Donated(y) ∧ In(y, x))) ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas that have mines which have been donated.
Conclusion:
∃x (MountainRange(x) ∧ In(x, texas) ∧ Visited(juanDeOnate, x)) ::: Juan de Onate visited a mountain range in Texas.
